title: Quick Chinese Farfalle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry made with farfalle pasta, vegetables, and a savory sauce. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook farfalle pasta according to package instructions.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add snow peas and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour sauce into the wok and stir to combine.
Add cooked farfalle pasta to the wok and toss to coat with the sauce.
